adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` is nil it unconditionally does `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ... embed_url: embed_url)` and renders `loading` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). The loading view reloads the page every 30s (app/views/embed/loading.html.erb), so an open embed will repeatedly hit `/embed/best` and enqueue a new `retrieve_topic` job each time until the embed exists. The 60s throttle is only enforced inside `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?` (lib/topic_retriever.rb) which runs when the job executes, not before enqueueing, so you can accumulate many redundant Sidekiq jobs that immediately no-op under the Redis throttle, creating avoidable queue/worker pressure and potentially unbounded job volume if retrieval keeps failing.
